events.title: [Day 01] Monorepo setup: pnpm, TypeScript, Biome, Vitest, CI
events.text: The Day 01 monorepo is in place on `day-01/monorepo-setup`, and the draft pull request is https://github.com/SergeiKamalian/rewind/pull/8. - `@rewind/shared` exports `version()` (`1`), with a unit test. - `@rewind/recorder` and `@rewind/player` depend on it through `workspace:*`. The player treats React 19 as a peer dependency. - `apps/demo` is a Vite todo list (add, toggle, delete). The footer reads **Format version 1** from `@rewind/shared`. - Root scripts cover `dev`, `build`, `lint`, `format`, `typecheck`, `test`, and `test:watch`. CI runs the same checks on Node 22 with a frozen lockfile. `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build` all passed locally. I also used the running demo to add todos, mark one done, and delete another. [demo_todos_add_toggle_delete.mp4](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-ec9d4924-a33a-4105-b5cf-b9c19b5c646b/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fdemo_todos_add_toggle_delete.mp4) [Demo todo after add, toggle, and delete](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-ec9d4924-a33a-4105-b5cf-b9c19b5c646b/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fdemo_todo_final.png) CI on the pull request is still queued. I will update the definition-of-done checkbox when it finishes. To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.

### QA passed
Tested https://rewind-osz9mzrne-sergeikamalian.vercel.app as a user, without access to the code.

Ran S1–S13 on desktop (1280x800) and mobile (390x844), including keyboard-only use, empty/spaces/long titles, rapid clicks, reload, and back navigation. All flows matched the product brief: add, trim, toggle done, delete, empty state, and footer. No bugs reproduced; console stayed clean.

| | Scenario | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| ✅ | Initial load shows Todos UI and empty state | Heading, New todo field, Add, No todos yet, no console errors. |
| ✅ | Add todo with Add button | Walk the dog appears; field clears. |
| ✅ | Add todo with Enter | Feed the cat / Via enter added via Enter. |
| ✅ | Reject empty and spaces-only titles | Empty click and spaces-only add nothing. |
| ✅ | Trim surrounding spaces |   Buy milk   /   Trim me   stored trimmed. |
| ✅ | 500-character title stays usable | Added; ellipsis truncates display; no layout overflow on either viewport. |
| ✅ | Add 20 todos quickly in order | All 20 appear in add order on desktop and mobile. |
| ✅ | Tick and untick done state | line-through when done; normal when undone. |
| ✅ | Delete middle todo only | Only the chosen middle item removed. |
| ✅ | Delete all shows empty state | No todos yet. returns after clearing. |
| ✅ | Footer Format version 1 | Visible on both viewports. |
| ✅ | Keyboard-only add, toggle, delete | Enter add, Space toggle, Enter on Delete all work. |
| ✅ | Mobile regression S2–S10 | 390x844; no

### QA failed
Tested https://rewind-aomtt7gp9-sergeikamalian.vercel.app as a user, without access to the code.

Ran S1–S3 and edge cases on desktop (1280x800) and mobile (390x844). Add, trim, empty input, toggle done, keyboard use, reload, and the footer all behave as specified. Delete is broken: every Delete button removes the first todo instead of the one you clicked, so S1, S2, and the smoke delete step all fail.

| | Scenario | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| ❌ | Add three todos and delete the middle one | After deleting Two, list is Two + Three; One is removed. Reproduced twice on desktop and mobile. |
| ❌ | Add two todos and delete the last one | Deleting Second leaves Second; First is removed. Same wrong-target delete as S1. Reproduced twice. |
| ❌ | Smoke check from qa/product.md | Load, add two, toggle done/undo, footer, empty/trim, and keyboard add/toggle pass. Deleting the second todo removes the first instead. |

**New bugs:** #11 (critical)
**Blocking merge:** #11

events.title: [Demo] Planted bug for the QA demo
events.text: Delete now removes the todo whose button was pressed. I pushed `fix(demo): delete removes the clicked todo (#11)` to `qa-demo/planted-bug` on PR #10, and left issue #11 open for QA to re-test. `deleteTodo` was ignoring the clicked id and dropping the first item with `slice(1)`. It now keeps every todo except the one with that id. Lint, typecheck, tests, and build all passed. I checked the same cases from the screenshots on the running demo: deleting Two leaves One and Three, and deleting Second leaves First, on both desktop and a narrow layout. [After deleting Two, One and Three remain](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-88b7bd4e-bf9f-4a79-bff0-93b751f57f18/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fscreenshots%2Fdelete_middle_leaves_one_and_three.png) [After deleting Second, only First remains](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-88b7bd4e-bf9f-4a79-bff0-93b751f57f18/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fscreenshots%2Fdelete_last_leaves_first.png) [delete_clicked_todo_desktop_and_mobile.mp4](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-88b7bd4e-bf9f-4a79-bff0-93b751f57f18/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Fdelete_clicked_todo_desktop_and_mobile.mp4) To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.
